hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */data/test/*|data/test/*) printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"data/test/ holds the 100 scored competition inputs. Modifying them invalidates every offset and every measurement. Restore with: git checkout -- data/test/\"}}";; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in *"/src/"*.py|*"/tests/"*.py) r=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 -m pytest tests/test_offsets.py -q -k "not silver" 2>&1); [ $? -eq 0 ] || printf "%s" "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Offset/schema validator FAILED after this edit:\n$(printf "%s" "$r" | tail -20 | sed "s/\"/\x27/g" | tr "\n" "~" | sed "s/~/\\\\n/g")\"}";; esac
